levels.surface: محمد بن الحسين بن أبي الخطاب

notes: The report opens «وعنه، بإسناده» (the previous report 233 writes its chain in full). How much of that chain is taken over is unclear, so the opening is written as a back_reference as it stands (inherited names not applied), per the rule.

«قال: وحدثني» starts a second isnad for the same saying (rule 4); its head is محمد بن الحسين. The first group ends at أبان before any matn: it has no saying of its own. The Imam «أبي جعفر» after «عن» is a narrator.
